1	import unittest
2	from api import update_preferences
3	from cli import clear_note
4	from settings import patch_settings
5	
6	
7	class SettingsTests(unittest.TestCase):
8	    def test_updates_note(self):
9	        original = {"note": "before", "enabled": True}
10	        result = update_preferences(original, {"note": "after"})
11	        self.assertEqual(result, {"note": "after", "enabled": True})
12	        self.assertEqual(original["note"], "before")
13	
14	    def test_explicit_falsey_values_replace_current(self):
15	        cases = [
16	            ("note None", {"note": None}, {"note": None, "enabled": True}),
17	            ("note empty", {"note": ""}, {"note": "", "enabled": True}),
18	            ("enabled False", {"enabled": False}, {"note": "before", "enabled": False}),
19	            ("both", {"note": None, "enabled": False}, {"note": None, "enabled": False}),
20	        ]
21	        for name, payload, expected in cases:
22	            with self.subTest(name):
23	                original = {"note": "before", "enabled": True}
24	                result = update_preferences(original, payload)
25	                self.assertEqual(result, expected)
26	                self.assertEqual(original, {"note": "before", "enabled": True})
27	
28	    def test_omitted_keys_keep_current_values(self):
29	        original = {"note": "before", "enabled": False}
30	        self.assertEqual(update_preferences(original, {}), original)
31	        self.assertEqual(
32	            update_preferences(original, {"enabled": True}),
33	            {"note": "before", "enabled": True},
34	        )
35	
36	    def test_clear_note_sets_none(self):
37	        original = {"note": "before", "enabled": True}
38	        result = clear_note(original)
39	        self.assertEqual(result, {"note": None, "enabled": True})
40	        self.assertEqual(original, {"note": "before", "enabled": True})
41	
42	    def test_does_not_mutate_caller_inputs(self):
43	        current = {"note": "before", "enabled": True}
44	        patch = {"note": "", "enabled": False}
45	        result = patch_settings(current, patch)
46	        self.assertEqual(result, {"note": "", "enabled": False})
47	        self.assertEqual(current, {"note": "before", "enabled": True})
48	        self.assertEqual(patch, {"note": "", "enabled": False})
49	        self.assertIsNot(result, current)
50	        self.assertIsNot(result, patch)
